newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says Jan-July refining output down 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says Jan-July refining output down 2.7 pct.

text.p: State oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Wednesday that refining output fell by 2.7 percent from the same period in 1995 to 1.61 million bpd of petroleum products.

"In the first seven months of 1996, the industrial centres of Pemex Refining and Pemex Gas and Basic Petrochemicals produced an average volume of 1.61 million barrels of petroleum products," Pemex said in a statement.

"This volume, which was 2.7 percent lower than that obtained in the period January-July last year, includes production of gasoline...diesel...jet fuel, kerosene, fuel oil and liquefied gas, among others."
It gave no explanation of why refining output was lower than last year.
Total average gasoline production in January-July, including naphthas used as petrochemical feedstock, was 503,600 bpd, up 0.6 percent from a year ago.
Output of diesel, desulphurised diesel and marine diesel was 263,500 bpd, down 2.2 percent.
Kerosenes output, including jet fuel, was 15 percent lower at 71,900 bpd. Fuel oil output was 421,900 bpd, down 3.2 percent.
Liquefied gas output was 266,600 bpd, up 2.1 percent.
